desc_en:
October has arrived.
I hope earnestly.
Please let my March beginner's mind and my April desperation show up for me once more this time.

Actually this sign was visible from my attitude preparing for June finals —
as if watching a building before collapse, that kind of pattern was observed in my attitude too.

This.. of course, if keeping beginner's mind were that easy everyone would do it, you might think,
but to throw away beginner's mind with that kind of rationalization is breaking a promise I made with myself,
so I don't want to do that.

If the most important issue in October is none other than second-semester midterms,
this is really important. First, among major courses, statics is especially important,
and I have to work even harder on it.

In the end I have to do neuroscience.
But no matter how I look, the graphs in neuroscience — of course this is only my observation so far —
no matter how I look, they feel like dynamical systems..?

Of course after doing dynamics, cognitive neuroscience, and computational neuroscience,
to some extent I might go hmm.. no, reality is different,
but my observation until now is like that.

But these days I often think like this.
Why didn't artificial intelligence develop intuition that much?
No matter how I search, the answer isn't clear.

Let's think.
Assume a seven-year-old.
Of course.. of course someone here might say..

??: Kid, that's thanks to home education
this time I'll push back. Then we also invest that much cost and compute to train —
does home education run learning millions of times.. adjust the child's weights and all that?
That's not it.

WLOG back to the main point.
Think: a seven-year-old.
Second floor. Looking below the window, they definitely think.

It would be dangerous to fall.

~~Of course sadly children sometimes fall,
I think those children are for lighting up physics later.~~

But those children don't feel that because they know F = ma
or gravitational acceleration.
And moreover at the table, if you push food like this from here,

this plastic cup will fall.
But this pot won't fall.
